$comment: Completion bar for #96: stop excluding src/plugins/** (2,714 lines) from renderer coverage, so the plugin views count (at their real %, 0 where untested) instead of vanishing from the Codecov denominator. Criterion 1 fails while the exclude is present; 2 fails unless an untested plugin view actually appears in the renderer lcov (proves the files are reported, not merely un-excluded); 3 keeps the merged pipeline green. The renderer Codecov status stays informational here; making it blocking is #85.
